headline: Kai, the long bond just closed above 5.3% for the first time since 2007, and this morning everything else is repricing around it.
subline: Iran's deal deadline expired with oil near two-week highs, Home Depot reports before the open, and July's Fed minutes land tomorrow.
asof: Pre-market · sources as of 5:00–6:40 AM ET · index and gold figures are futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Stocks fell Monday as oil jumped 3%
items.sentence: The S&P 500 closed at 7,745.06, down 0.5%, as Brent jumped about 3% to above $88 on fading US-Iran hopes and the 30-year yield's first finish above 5.3% since June 2007, per Eurasia Business News.

items.title: Futures extend losses; Nasdaq off 1%
items.sentence: S&P 500 futures trade at 7,729.25, down 0.51%, Nasdaq-100 futures are off 1.11%, and WTI sits at $84.15 with the 30-year yield at a 19-year high, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Fed minutes tomorrow: watch the three dissents
items.sentence: Three officials dissented in favor of higher rates when the Fed held in July, with inflation still solidly above 3%, and Wednesday's minutes will show how close the committee came, per AP.

items.title: Home Depot reports before the open
items.sentence: Consensus looks for EPS of $4.71 from a stock down 10.7% over 52 weeks on rate-pressured housing demand, with Toll Brothers and Klarna also on today's slate, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Bitcoin steadies above $64,000
items.sentence: Bitcoin trades near $64,170 after buyers defended support around last week's $62,700 low, though spot ETFs bled $385 million over the same stretch, per the Sunday Guardian.

items.title: Iran deadline expires; Trump threatens Oman
items.sentence: The deadline for a US-Iran deal expired Monday, and Trump is now threatening action against Oman over interference with Strait of Hormuz shipping, per CNN and Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Russian drone hits Odesa shopping center
items.sentence: Russia launched 128 drones overnight, killing at least nine and injuring 43 across Ukraine in a day, including a jet-powered drone strike on a post office inside an Odesa shopping center, per the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: European yields hit multi-year highs
items.sentence: France's 10-year reached 4.10%, its highest since June 2009, and Germany's bund topped 3.25% as the US-Iran breakdown feeds inflation fears, with markets pricing a 90% chance of an ECB hike by September, per Euronews.

items.title: Petroleum reserve at lowest level since 1982
items.sentence: The US Strategic Petroleum Reserve has drained to its lowest level since 1982, just as Hormuz risk pushes oil to two-week highs, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Putin pledges North Korea ties 'in all the sectors'
items.sentence: Putin said cooperation with Pyongyang will continue 'in all the sectors,' as Kyiv says Russia is preparing to receive another 30,000 North Korean troops, per the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: GitHub down worldwide for much of Monday
items.sentence: Microsoft confirmed a global outage that impaired GitHub's site, APIs and Copilot for much of Monday, per BleepingComputer.

items.title: Copilot 'autofix' opened Snowflake to attack
items.sentence: A Copilot-generated 'autofix' left a command-injection flaw in Snowflake's GitHub Actions that Wiz's red-team AI agent then exploited to reach an internal Jira, per The Register.

items.title: Amazon destroys rare books for AI training
items.sentence: Amazon — the company that began as a bookstore — is dismantling and scanning rare titles for model training data, a tracked shipment shows, per 404 Media.

items.title: Meta, Nvidia plant flag in open-weight race
items.sentence: Meta and Nvidia planted a 'very firm flag' in the open-weight AI race that Chinese labs have been leading, per CNBC.

items.title: AI borrowing spree shows up in yields
items.sentence: Bond analysts cite significant AI-related debt issuance, on top of heavy government borrowing, as a driver of the global yield surge, per Euronews.
